attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2, and node3 (standbys) on CentOS Stream 10, secured entirely over TLS using a dedicated cluster CA. Generated a CA and per-node server certs plus a shared client cert (CN=replicator) on node1, distributed via SSH, and configured pg_hba.conf with hostssl+cert-only rules restricted to the three node IPs (non-SSL and non-CA-signed-cert replication attempts are rejected). Standbys were provisioned via pg_basebackup -R over sslmode=verify-full, confirmed streaming with TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 ciphers and cert auth, and validated with live data replication. Ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol (node2, node3, then node1) with boot-id proof of each restart and full data/replication recovery confirmed afterward, including a post-restart write propagating to both standbys.
